description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and mock implementations for DNS testing within the Chromium project, including building DNS records, responses, and mock transaction behaviors.

classes.name: MockAddressSorter
classes.description: A mock implementation of AddressSorter that runs the callback immediately with the provided endpoints.

classes.name: MockDnsClientRule::Result
classes.description: Represents the result of a mock DNS client rule, including response type, optional DNS response, and network error.

classes.name: MockDnsTransactionFactory::MockTransaction
classes.description: A mock implementation of DnsTransaction that returns predefined responses based on rules.

classes.name: MockDnsTransactionFactory::MockDohProbeRunner
classes.description: A mock DNS over HTTPS probe runner that tracks start calls.

classes.name: MockDnsClient
classes.description: A mock DNS client that simulates DNS transactions and configurations for testing purposes.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsRecord
methods.description: Creates a DNS resource record with specified name, type, data, and TTL.

methods.name: BuildTestAddressRecord
methods.description: Creates an A or AAAA DNS record based on the IP address.

methods.name: BuildTestTextRecord
methods.description: Creates a TXT DNS record with given text strings.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsAliasRecord
methods.description: Creates an HTTPS alias DNS record.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceAlpnParam
methods.description: Builds an ALPN parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceEchConfigParam
methods.description: Builds an ECH config parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceMandatoryParam
methods.description: Builds a mandatory parameter list for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServicePortParam
methods.description: Builds a port parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceRecord
methods.description: Creates an HTTPS service DNS record with specified parameters.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsResponse
methods.description: Constructs a DNS response with specified answer, authority, and additional records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsAddressResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with an address record.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsAddressResponseWithCname
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with address and CNAME records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsTextResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with TXT records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsPointerResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with PTR records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsServiceResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with SRV records.

methods.name: CreateMalformedResponse
methods.description: Creates a malformed DNS response with a valid question but missing answer.
